scientific_integrity: Exact all-length theorem follows from finite inclusion–exclusion and verified 4x4 determinant products. Small-length direct enumeration is corroboration only, not a substitute for proof. Sources and known capacity credited.

title: Exact periodic length-two DNA secondary-structure-avoidance zeta function
